name: Ziarno
tagline: warm crema paper, espresso ink, one terracotta accent
overview: Ziarno reads like a well-printed café menu: a warm crema page (#f6efe4) with espresso-brown text (#2b1d16), Fraunces serif headlines that carry the craft character, and Inter for everything functional [A1][A2]. A single terracotta accent (#c0622d) marks every primary action — ‘Zamów online’, ‘Zobacz menu’, prices on product cards — while sage green (#5f7a5b) is reserved for small eyebrow labels and confirmations [A1][A2][A3]. Cards sit on a slightly lighter paper (#fffaf3) with hairline borders and a barely-there shadow; corners are soft (16px) and buttons are full pills [A1][A2].

layout.description: A 64px side gutter and a single top navigation bar (logo left, links centered, primary CTA right) separated by a hairline [A1][A2]. The home hero is a two-column split: copy left, a featured product card right [A1]. The menu is a three-column grid of horizontal product cards with filter chips aligned to the section title [A2].

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta (#c0622d) pill, white Inter 15px/500 label, 44px tall, 22px horizontal padding, no border, no shadow.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent pill with 1px Espresso border and Espresso label, same size as the primary button (‘Kup ziarna’).

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: 36px pill, Inter 14px/500. Active: Espresso fill with white text; inactive: Paper with Hairline border and Espresso text.

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Paper card, 1px Hairline border, 16px radius, 16px padding; 84px square thumbnail (12px radius) left, Fraunces 19px name and Inter 14px description in the middle, Fraunces price and an outlined Terracotta ‘Dodaj’ pill right.

components.name: Featured Product Panel
components.description: Large Paper card with an image area (12px radius) and a footer row: Fraunces 22px product name, flavour notes in Roast Grey, Terracotta price pill.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Wordmark (terracotta circle mark + Fraunces 26px ‘Ziarno’), centered Inter 15px links in Roast Grey with the active one in Espresso/500, primary pill CTA on the right; 1px Hairline bottom border.

components.name: Confirmation Banner
components.description: Sage Mist background, 1px #cdd9c9 border, 16px radius, Sage dot + Inter 15px message with the item name in bold.

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Inter 12px/500, uppercase, 0.06em tracking, Sage — above headlines (‘MENU’, ‘PALARNIA RZEMIEŚLNICZA · KRAKÓW’).

voice.tone: Warm, concrete and a little proud of the craft — short sentences, real numbers (roast days, ratings, minutes), Polish informal ‘ty’.
examples: Kawa palona w poniedziałek, pita we wtorek.
Dodano do zamówienia: Flat white — odbiór za ok. 5 min.
Proposed: Ups, tego ziarna właśnie zabrakło — wróci w czwartek.

dos: Use Terracotta only for actions and prices — one accent per view
Set every headline and price in Fraunces; everything functional in Inter
Keep cards on Paper with a hairline border, not heavy shadows
Use pills for all buttons and chips
Write real, specific copy: origins, days, minutes
donts: Don't use pure white or pure black — always Paper/Crema and Espresso
Don't add a second accent hue next to Terracotta
Don't set body copy in Fraunces
Don't use sharp corners on cards or buttons
Don't stack more than one shadow
elevation: Almost flat: depth comes from the Paper-on-Crema contrast and 1px hairlines; the only shadow is 0 1px 2px at 6% espresso.
imagery: Warm, close-up coffee photography or rich brown gradients inside 12px-radius frames; flat colour swatches for drink thumbnails.

componentPrompts: Create a product card: Paper #fffaf3 background, 1px #e6dccd border, 16px radius, 16px padding; 84px thumbnail with 12px radius; name in Fraunces 19px #2b1d16; description Inter 14px #6f625a; price Fraunces 18px; outlined Terracotta ‘Dodaj’ pill 30px tall.

Create the top navigation: Crema background, 64px side padding, terracotta circle logo mark + Fraunces 26px wordmark, centered Inter 15px links (#6f625a, active #2b1d16/500), Terracotta pill CTA ‘Zamów online’, 1px #e6dccd bottom border.
Create a hero: eyebrow Inter 12px uppercase Sage, Fraunces 64px/1.05 headline in Espresso, Inter 17px body in Roast Grey, Terracotta primary pill + Espresso-outlined ghost pill.
